subject: Linguistics
title: Word Order Matters
description: Learn Word Order Matters in one minute.

hook.text: 'Dog bites man' is news. 'Man bites dog' is a headline. Same words, different order.

buildup.text: English follows Subject-Verb-Object order—change it and meaning collapses.

discovery.text: About 45 percent of languages use SOV order, like Japanese and Hindi.

twist.text: Some languages are free-order—Latin marks roles with endings, not position.

climax.text: Word order is one of the first things children master in any language.

punchline.text: Move a word and you move the meaning.

quiz.question: What word order does English primarily use?
